description: Gameplay on the tiny-sur-mer track of Pixel Wheels, recorded from the desktop build: a car starts a race, fires its rocket bonus, and the camera follows the rocket and car driving across a stone bridge/causeway that carries the road over water, past a checkered start-line banner strung between two angled poles spanning the road.
reproduces: https://github.com/agateau/pixelwheels/issues/362 (screenshot 2, 'River' track: side of the bridge) and https://github.com/agateau/pixelwheels/issues/58 (Tiny-sur-Mer tower)
scenario: A single player vehicle starts on the tiny-sur-mer track, drives onto the start/finish gate immediately in front of the spawn, fires a missile bonus a moment after the race starts, and the missile flies straight ahead across the checkered start-line banner strung between two poles over the stone causeway/bridge, then the car continues driving across the bridge
